title: llm.translate
description: Translate a {key: text} mapping between languages. Empty entries short-circuit to {status: 'ok', result: {}} without calling the provider. Returns {status: 'ok', result: {key: translated}} or {status: 'failure', reason: string}. Every reply that wrote ledger rows also carries metering: {provider, model, cost_usd, cost_basis, priced_by, input_tokens, output_tokens, thinking_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, audio_duration_ms, duration_ms, fallback_used, calls} — sums over every provider call this request made (fallback chain, map-reduce, retries); provider/model name the call that produced the result; a checkpoint or cache hit reports cost_usd 0 with cost_basis 'cached'. An optional context {recording_id, stage, run_id, attempt} is stored on each PromptLog row as metadata.context.

from_lang.description: Source language code, or 'auto' to auto-detect.

entries.description: Mapping of keys to source-language strings.

user_id.description: Who this call is for — recorded on the PromptLog row so per-user cost is answerable. Opaque to this package: any id shape the host uses. Optional; omitting it leaves the row unattributed, never rejected.

workspace_id.description: Which tenant this call is for — recorded on the PromptLog row so per-workspace cost is answerable without summing over its members. Optional, opaque, recorded only.

context.description: Who this call is FOR inside the caller's own pipeline (a recording, the stage, the run and the attempt). Stored on every PromptLog row the call writes, under metadata.context; recorded only, never acted on.
